title: Improve Concrete Indifferentiability Bounds for Iterated Even-Mansour
summary: The established results have typically poor concrete indifferentiability bounds, and improving them remains open.

formal_statement.body: For iterated Even--Mansour constructions, improve the currently poor concrete indifferentiability bounds in each setting where indifferentiability has been established: five rounds with a non-idealized key schedule and three rounds with a non-invertible idealized key schedule.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptography focused on concrete indifferentiability bounds for iterated Even--Mansour constructions.
parameters: Five rounds: round count in the non-idealized key-schedule setting
Three rounds: round count in the non-invertible idealized key-schedule setting
Non-invertible idealized key schedule: key-schedule setting
scope.unresolved_remainder: Improve the currently poor concrete indifferentiability bounds in each of the two settings where indifferentiability has been established.

citations.label: Indifferentiability of Iterated Even-Mansour Ciphers with Non-idealized Key-Schedules: Five Rounds Are Necessary and Sufficient

progress.summary: The source explicitly identifies this as the main open question in both settings. It says the concrete indifferentiability bounds are typically poor and asks whether they can be improved.
citation_labels: Yuanxi Dai et al., Indifferentiability of Iterated Even-Mansour Ciphers with Non-idealized Key-Schedules: Five Rounds Are Necessary and Sufficient
